title: A machine's report to its hub (machine-report/1, DEC-0132)
description: What one machine of an estate tells the estate's hub machine over the relay, or, on the hub's own machine, through the node's machine.report on the local channel (DEC-0132, CT-152): the estate record revision it applied, the heartbeat it accepted, the head of the revocation delta it applied, and the window leases it holds with what it spent, under the same member names as a check-in's records (DEC-0053, DEC-0056, DEC-0062), which DEC-0128 UE-2 keeps off every check-in to an organization server. Over the relay, the plaintext of a fabric-machine-report/1 sealed to the hub's #kem (machine-report-sealed.schema.json), which the relay reads none of; on the local channel the node's answer itself, unsealed. Each lease once (FAC-SEM-152); at a relay time (FAC-SEM-154). docs/specification/relay.md#the-machines-report.

machine.description: The reporting machine's id in the estate record; the hub refuses a report whose machine is not the one relayCallerTier named for the body's sender, or, for its own node's machine.report on the local channel, not its own machine id (wrong-machine).

at.description: When the machine wrote the report. A relay time: Z, an upper-case T, at most nine fraction digits, a day that exists (FAC-SEM-154, DEC-0146). The hub keeps, per machine, the report with the latest at and refuses one not after it, to the nanosecond (stale), one whose at is no relay time, and one whose at is after the body's signed iat, or after the hub's clock for its own node's answer (malformed, DEC-0139, DEC-0146).

leases.description: Every window lease the machine holds, and the newest expired lease of each slot whose window instance has not ended, each with its latest spent (MR-1, DEC-0062's reporting); a spent covers the whole instance, so later reports keep naming a lease until its instance ends and the newest report alone carries the machine's whole state. Empty when it holds none.

records.description: The check-in's records members, by the same names and shapes: estateRecord (revision and optional digest), heartbeat (sequence, at), revocationDelta (sequence, sha256), leases ({leaseId, expiresAt, spent}).
